title: vpc-terraform-upgrade-autopilot-preflight-and-policy-evaluator
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an automated preflight + upgrade orchestration flow for VPC/private deployments that runs IaC linting, plan scoring, and policy evaluation before any apply. The flow should: 1) run fast static linting and module validation, 2) generate an enriched terraform plan with metadata (resource owner, risk score, diff-size), 3) evaluate with Rego/OPA policies and a custom plan-scoring heuristic, 4) gate apply with configurable thresholds and human review steps, and 5) emit health-check probes post-apply that validate networking, service reachability, and state drift. Goal is to reduce upgrade rollbacks and provide deterministic safety for Private deployments and on-prem upgrades.
acceptance_criteria: CI pipeline stage 'iac-preflight' executes lint -> plan -> plan-score -> policy-eval in < 10 minutes for typical VPC module
Plan scoring returns numeric score and blocks applies when score >= 70 (configurable).
OPA/Rego policies enforce: no public subnets without approval, encryption-at-rest on DB modules, restricted IAM/role changes, and tag/owner metadata presence.
A manual approval step is inserted for high-score plans with automated templated justification summary.
Post-apply health checks run automatically and emit 'healthy' or 'rollback' signals; failed health-checks trigger an automated safe-fail remediation runbook.
All metadata, plan artifacts, and policy decisions are stored to the audit log and linked to the rollout in Console for troubleshooting.
technical_notes: We will leverage 'terraform plan -out' and a plan->json converter to enrich diffs with resource counts and change types.
Plan-scoring service prototype is a small Go microservice that computes weighted risk based on change type (create/delete/replace), resource criticality, and owner endorsement.
OPA will be used for policy-as-code; policies live in 'infra/policies' repo and loaded via docker OPA server step in pipeline.
For speed, linting uses tflint + custom module schema checks; caching of module downloads via terraform-plugin-cache layer.

State promotion strategy: use blue/green workspace naming convention and a short-lived shadow workspace for validation. Apply is performed only after health probes pass against shadow environment where applicable.
Support both cloud (AWS) and on-prem variants: module tags to toggle provider-specific probes.
